Name: Stardew Fantasy
Author: Xangriaa
Description:
[size=3]﻿A collection of fantasy items, crops, and recipes.
Inspired by items from various worlds including those of Final Fantasy and Harry Potter. [/size]

[size=3]The initial version is small, but future plans can be found on my linked Github.
Feel free to suggests any items that fit theme, and I'll do what I can to include them.
[/size]
